estimation.preserves: the value vLLM sets itself when the environment does not state one (nixl_utils.py:20-36@5df63a72)

the NIC path the engine prices for a handoff between nodes when UCX_CUDA_IPC_ENABLE_MNNVL=y is not stated (compat/kernelmodel): a transport list that names an RDMA transport, or all, reaches the NIC; a deny list or a list with no RDMA transport does not. UCX FAQ for the list syntax; no vLLM function resolves it

the backend vLLM's _resolve_fi_ar_backend picks for the tensor-parallel group (flashinfer_all_reduce.py:143-178@5df63a72). One node: auto picks mnnvl with a trtllm fallback when the multicast workspace cannot be created, and a stated mnnvl picks mnnvl with no fallback, so the two differ only on a node without NVSwitch multicast. Several nodes: auto picks mnnvl without fallback on compute capability 10.0 and up, and turns FlashInfer all-reduce off below it.
